light_description: Two-channel bass preamp with independent clean and distortion channels; important SPI historical product but not treated as a dedicated central dirt pedal.
IKUO collaboration filter for shaping slap bass response; documented as a filter rather than a dirt pedal.
IKUO collaboration one-knob bass booster emphasizing low-B clarity and high-end output; not a dedicated dirt pedal.
SPI modification of an MXR M-80 Bass D.I.+ combining modified drive and boost functions; retained as a third-party modification relationship.
Prototype signature overdrive for guitarist John Kanda, documented at Sound Messe 2023 with germanium transistor gain and a four-band EQ section with two independently voiced mid bands.
Sound Dog low-boost booster designed to retain low-end when increasing volume or gain; classified by Japanese retailers as a booster, outside central dirt.
Sound Dog modulation pedal documented as a phaser; preserved as a builder-history relationship but excluded from central dirt inventory.
Earlier-design presentation of BLUE DOG documented by a Japanese dealer; retained as a historical/finish variant rather than a new conceptual model.
